# Human reminder recordings — 1.0.100

## Five approach announcements

The user explicitly approved a real human recording without requiring a documented religious title on 2026-10-29.
Publisher: Ramy Elshiekh; recordings published 2018-10-27.
The publisher identifies the voice as his own and expressly invites sharing and inclusion in mobile adhan applications. His surname is not evidence of a religious title. No speaker name is shown in the UI.

## Fajr phrase

One contiguous occurrence from the existing Fajr adhan, source214.2–228.2s. This replaces the engineered SoundCloud recording reported as overlapping by the user; the old clip is removed from the current package.
Source: https://github.com/Five-Prayers/five-prayers-android/blob/main/app/src/main/res/raw/adhan_fajr_al_haram_el_madani_saoudia.mp3
The source identifies the Madani mosque recording, without authenticating an individual performer. Existing audio attribution is retained in ../SOURCES.txt.

## Verification limits

All six are existing human performances; no synthesis, voice cloning, pitch changes, word assembly or AI enhancement was used. Conventional crop, conservative gain and MP3 encoding only. Exact duration, boundaries and hashes are in verification.json. ASR and no-clipping checks do not prove subjective listening quality. Rapid replacements and cross-owner output exclusivity have executable web and Java regression tests. No physical-phone listening is claimed.
